title: Directives Overview
description: Directives are classes that add additional behavior to elements in your Angular applications.

blocks.text: Directives are classes that add additional behavior to elements in your Angular applications. Use Angular's built-in directives to manage forms, lists, styles, and what users see.
The different types of Angular directives are as follows:

items: Components: Directives with a template. This type of directive is the most common directive type.
Attribute directives: Directives that change the appearance or behavior of an element, component, or another directive.
Structural directives: Directives that change the DOM layout by adding and removing DOM elements.
